purpose: Define preservation of lineage across UserModule instance, relation-bound and remote DWH boundaries so remote/local projection does not erase origin provenance.

owns: DWH Cross-Instance and Remote Lineage semantics

value.instance_rule: Lineage preserves full source UserModule instance identity.
value.relation_rule: Relation-bound data retains relation/FK provenance used to traverse between instances.
value.remote_rule: Remote DWH data retains origin instance/schema/resource identity plus governed remote-address provenance.
value.ext_rule: EXT endpoint registration may appear as transport/addressing provenance but never replaces remote semantic source identity.
value.copy_rule: Explicit import/copy creates a new local data identity while retaining lineage to remote/original source.
value.projection_rule: Read-only projection does not create new semantic ownership merely by crossing instance boundaries.
value.privacy_rule: Lineage detail exposure may be redacted while internal provenance remains preserved according to policy.
